ja178:1.1: janittaṁ me bhavittaṁ me → janittamme bhavittamme (bj) | janittaṁ → janitaṁ (sya-all) | bhavittaṁ → bhavitaṁ (sya-all) | bhavittamme → janitaṁ me bhavitaṁ me (bj: syā)
ja178:2.3:
janittaṁ bhavittañca → janitaṁ bhavitañca (sya-all) | bhavittañca → taṁ janitaṁ bhavitañca jānitaṁ – syā 
bhāvitanti dighavasenāpi pāṭho soyevattho – a.jā (bj note)
ja178:2.5: yamhi → yahiṁ (sya-all) | tamhi → tahiṁ (sya-all) | tamhi → yahiṁ jive kahiṁ gacche (bj: syā)
